instructions: Heat the oil (about 1/2 cup + 1/3 cup) in a large pot.
Fry the onion until brown, about 10 minutes. Add the garlic, mix, then add the meat and fry for 10-15 minutes.
Add the zera and the salt. Add all the vegetables and fry for about 7 minutes, mixing.
Add the V8, hot paprika, and cayenne pepper. Bring to a boil and cook for 7 minutes.
Add 4 cups of water. Once it comes up to a boil, skim off any scum that rises from the oil, then lower the heat and simmer for 30-45 minutes.
Cook the noodles separately according to the package directions. Serve the lagman over the noodles.
notes: Transcribed from a handwritten recipe photo. A few readings are best-effort and worth checking against the original: the meat has no quantity written; the celery is written as a circled 1 (read as 1 stalk); the potato line reads '2 circled, 1 potato' (read as 1 potato); the V8 and tomato sauce quantities were squeezed into the right margin (1 large can V8, 1 cup V8 Hot & Spicy, 1 can tomato sauce); the salt in the instructions was corrected from tbsp to tsp in the handwriting; the oil is written as 'about 1/2 cup + 1/3 cup'. 'Zera' is cumin seeds. Servings and times are estimates - the original gives no servings or meat quantity.

tips.text: Cook the noodles separately and ladle the lagman over them - the noodles are not cooked in the sauce.
tips.title: Noodles

tips.text: Check that the V8 and tomato sauce are certified kosher.
